rule.score: mean relative velocity vector L2 + mean relative pressure L2 + 0.5*(MAE lnK + MAE lnDeltaP)
rule.rule: Use the best mean validation score across the two seeds. Prefer plain U-Net unless an enhanced candidate improves mean score by >=3%, wins both paired seeds, and does not regress any task by >5%. If enhanced candidates differ by <1%, prefer lower measured epoch time.
